chunks: 1252 - “Travel and striving to fulfill needs on the morning of Friday are disliked because of the prayer. But as for after the prayer, then it is permissible, and blessing is sought through it.”
That was reported in the reply to al-Sarī from Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام.

key_terms.السَّعْيُ: striving or going out to pursue matters
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the prayer, here referring to the Friday prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to travel on Friday morning before the Jumu‘ah prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that traveling and pursuing worldly needs early on Friday is disliked due to the salat of Jumu‘ah. After the prayer has been performed, such activity becomes permissible and is described as blessed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1252 - It is disliked to travel and seek to fulfil needs on the morning of Jumu’ah due to the (obligation of) the Jumu’ah prayer. However, after the prayer, it is permissible and brings blessings."
This was mentioned in response to a question by al-Sari from Imam Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad (as).
